source:
@@U01792@@
I'm dying!
Quickly said and quickly done.
Why are you standing there howling?
Come here.
Listen.

@@U01793@@
(They all gather round him.)

@@U01794@@
Listen to me, 格蕾琴—
you're young,
young but not very clever where it counts,
and you've made a real mess of things.
Let me tell you something.
You're a whore,
so you might as well play it to the hilt.

@@U01796@@
My brother!
Dear God!
What are you saying?

@@U01798@@
Leave God out of this!
What's done is done.
You began on the sly with one,
but there'll be more, count on it,
and when you've had a dozen
the whole town can come calling.
Shame’s birth is a secret thing,
her little ears and head
are hidden by night in a veil of darkness,
and all would like to kill and forget her.
But she grows, she grows,
and parades around brazenly
in broad daylight,
and not any prettier.
And the uglier she grows,
the more she seeks out daylight.
translation:
@@U01792@@
我快死了！
说得快，做得也快。
你为什么站在那里嚎叫？
过来吧。
听。

@@U01793@@
（他们都聚集在他周围。）

@@U01794@@
听我说，格蕾琴——
你还年轻，
年轻但在重要的地方不太聪明，
你把事情搞得一团糟。
让我告诉你一件事。
你是个妓女，
所以你不妨尽情发挥。

@@U01796@@
我的兄弟！
亲爱的上帝！
你在说什么？

@@U01798@@
让上帝远离这一切吧！
已经完成的事情已经完成了。
你偷偷地开始了一个，
但还会有更多，相信它，
当你有十几个的时候
全镇的人都可以来打电话。
耻辱的诞生是一件秘密的事情，
她的小耳朵和头
夜晚隐藏在黑暗的面纱中，
所有人都想杀死她并忘记她。
但她长大了，她长大了，
并肆无忌惮地四处游行
光天化日之下，
而且也没有更漂亮。
而且她越长越丑
她越是寻求阳光。
